effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: Cannot see; automatically fails sight-based checks and attacks at disadvantage.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Cannot attack the charmer, who has advantage on social checks against the target.

effects.name: Deafened
effects.description: Cannot hear; automatically fails hearing-based checks.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: Disadvantage while the source of fear is in sight, and cannot willingly approach it.

effects.name: Fear
effects.description: Panic that overrides tactics; the victim flees or freezes.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Speed drops to zero until the grapple ends.

effects.name: Incapacitated
effects.description: Can take no actions or reactions.

effects.name: Invisible
effects.description: Cannot be seen without magic; attacks against the target are made at disadvantage.

effects.name: Paralyzed
effects.description: Incapacitated and unable to move or speak; nearby attacks land as critical hits.

effects.name: Petrified
effects.description: Transformed to stone, unaware of surroundings, and resistant to all damage.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

effects.name: Prone
effects.description: Knocked flat; movement costs double and melee attackers gain advantage.

effects.name: Restrained
effects.description: Speed is zero, attacks are made at disadvantage, and dexterity saves suffer.

effects.name: Stunned
effects.description: Incapacitated, unable to move, and barely able to speak.

effects.name: Unconscious
effects.description: Prone, incapacitated, and unaware of anything happening nearby.

effects.name: Exhaustion
effects.description: Cumulative fatigue that erodes speed, accuracy, and finally life itself.

effects.name: Burning
effects.description: Flames cling to the target and keep searing it each round.

effects.name: Heated Armor
effects.description: Metal armor glows hot, scalding the wearer.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.description: Numbing cold slows movement and dulls reactions.

effects.name: Shock
effects.description: Muscles lock under a surge of electricity, costing the victim its reaction.

effects.name: Infection
effects.description: A festering wound that worsens without treatment.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.description: An open wound that keeps costing blood until it is bound.

effects.name: Entangled
effects.description: Roots, webs, or vines hold the target fast.

effects.name: Silenced
effects.description: No sound can be made, blocking any spell that needs a spoken word.

effects.name: Blessed
effects.description: A faint radiance steadies the target's aim and nerve.

effects.name: Hasted
effects.description: Time seems to slow; the target moves and acts far faster than normal.

effects.name: Slowed
effects.description: Every movement drags as if through deep water.

effects.name: Invigorated
effects.description: Vitality floods back into the target.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.description: Wounds knit closed a little more each round.

effects.name: Stabilized
effects.description: A dying creature stops losing life and holds on at zero.

effects.name: Area Damage
effects.description: Harm spread across everything caught in the area.

effects.name: Knockback
effects.description: Force enough to hurl the target away from its attacker.

effects.name: Advantage on Attack
effects.description: Roll the attack twice and keep the better result.

effects.name: Life Drain
effects.description: Life is torn from the victim and fed to the attacker.

effects.name: Staggered
effects.description: Knocked off balance: disadvantage on the next attack and movement halved until the end of its next turn.

effects.name: Gravity Pull
effects.description: Dragged up to 3 m (10 ft) toward the centre of a collapsing gravity well.

effects.name: Anchored
effects.description: Its own weight multiplies: speed 0 until the start of the caster's next turn.

effects.name: Gravity Shift
effects.description: Own gravity bent: either feather-light (jump twice as far, no falling damage, can run along walls) or anchored (cannot be shoved, pushed or knocked prone).

effects.name: Guard Stance
effects.description: +1 AC until the start of the next turn.

effects.name: Blade Oath
effects.description: Weapon hits deal +1 piercing damage.

effects.name: Compelled Duel
effects.description: Pulled toward the challenger and has disadvantage on attacks against anyone else.

effects.name: Concussed
effects.description: Head ringing: disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

effects.name: Armor Broken
effects.description: Armour pierced or knocked askew: -2 AC.

effects.name: Weakened
effects.description: Its blows land without strength: deals half damage.

effects.name: Shield of Faith
effects.description: A shimmering field of faith: +2 AC.

effects.name: Guided
effects.description: Add 1d4 to one ability check of choice before the effect ends.

effects.name: Aided
effects.description: Bolstered: maximum and current HP +3 for 8 hours.

effects.name: Spirit Upkeep
effects.description: Keeping a spirit companion in a physical body drains the summoner's own life every turn. Remove when the spirit is dismissed.

effects.name: No Healing
effects.description: Cannot regain HP from life drain. The Caretaker carries this while he is off the rose-bed soil.
